scope.included: Sourced reconstruction: consume START_RECONSTRUCTION task, validate MCP-derived pre-invoice events, persist immutable reconstruction version with seven charged days, coverage, events, outbox; public projection for Gate 3/4
scope.environment: isolated CockroachDB database tally_gate2_iso (same cluster as the protected hero defaultdb, which was verified UNCHANGED; cluster identifier retained privately)

source_fixture.disclosure: Representative demonstration data. Not a live carrier or terminal feed.

verification.requirement: immutable reconstruction versioning with fingerprint idempotency
verification.public_evidence: complete_reconstruction writes one version per (invoice, input_fingerprint); a duplicated delivery replays the existing version and writes no second row (unit) and the version unique index is enforced (migration 010).

verification.requirement: every accepted event carries source, version, provenance, and distinct time domains; no event after the knowledge cutoff
verification.public_evidence: validate_events rejects events recorded after the invoice received_at cutoff, unverified source bindings, cross-shipment/container events, non-allowlisted types, naive timestamps, and duplicates; occurred/recorded/observed times are stored as distinct columns; recorded_before_cutoff is server-derived.

verification.requirement: deterministic free-time/gate-out boundary in the scenario timezone
verification.public_evidence: Boundary policy computes first-chargeable = day after free-time-end and last-chargeable = gate-out date, in America/Los_Angeles. A live-caught UTC-truncation bug (June 8 dropped) was fixed and regression-tested.

verification.requirement: seven charged days each source-complete with bound events
verification.public_evidence: Live positive trace on tally_gate2_iso: 5 events accepted, 7 charged-day rows, 7 source-complete, reconstruction state COMPLETE, 1 public reconstruction event + 1 outbox row read back.

verification.requirement: atomic transition (reconstruction + events + days + coverage + invoice status + public event + outbox) and late-worker fencing
verification.public_evidence: Repository transaction commits all rows in one dal.run_with_retry body; a lost lease raises before any write (unit); completion/failure UPDATEs re-assert current_attempt + lease_owner.

verification.requirement: Managed MCP read is load-bearing with NO direct-SQL/fixture/model fallback
verification.public_evidence: The fixed bounded SELECT runs only through the read-only Managed MCP client; MCP unavailable/unauthorized/malformed/empty all route to fail_reconstruction (BLOCKED/NEEDS_EVIDENCE) and never to complete_reconstruction (unit, 6 no-fallback cases). The worker never opens a driver connection on the MCP failure path.

verification.requirement: counterfactual: a missing/unavailable source produces a gap, not a success
verification.public_evidence: Live negative trace on tally_gate2_iso: GATE_OUT source version UNAVAILABLE -> the MCP read view excludes it -> boundary cannot form -> 0 source-complete days -> terminal NEEDS_EVIDENCE -> no COMPLETE reconstruction. mock_fallback:false.

verification.requirement: public projection exposes no private identifiers
verification.public_evidence: The reconstruction projection returns verification state and public refs only; a leak scan asserts absence of s3 bucket/key/version, SQL, correlation, and private-anchor tokens (unit).

deployed_readback.note: The positive/negative live traces read the mcp_reconstruction_memory_v1 view through the CockroachDB DRIVER because the isolated lineage has no provisioned Managed MCP endpoint (SSM has only the hero /tally/gate5/mcp-* config, scoped to the protected defaultdb). The driver read is explicitly labeled a diagnostic and is NOT the Managed MCP sponsor trace. The worker's real MCP path is unit-proven fail-closed.

live_managed_mcp.detail: A real read-only Managed MCP read ran against the isolated tally_gate2_iso database (same cluster MCP, database overridden). The identity was verified read-only (write tool denied); the fixed reconstruction SELECT returned the hero events; the deterministic validator accepted exactly 5 hero events; reconstruction reached 7/7 COMPLETE. mock_fallback:false. Reproduce: re-auth via scripts.gate5b_oauth_bootstrap, then scripts.gate2_live_mcp_trace.

explicit_deferrals.statement: Gate 3 applicable-rule (applicable_rate_minor), Gate 4 judgment/outcome, approval, seal, send
explicit_deferrals.reason: Later gates; deliberately left OPEN. Charged-day applicable_rate_minor/outcome remain null/PENDING in Gate 2 by design.

downstream_contract.shape: reconstruction_id, version, state, knowledge_cutoff, effective_timezone, source_disclosure, timeline[], charged_days[] (invoice_rate_minor, applicable_rate_minor=null until Gate 3/4, coverage, event_refs, missing_requirements), coverage{days_complete, days_total, requirements, missing_requirements}
